name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: DevDigest AI Marketplace — a catalog of Claude Code plugins (agents, skills, commands) maintained independently of the DevDigest product repo, with its own release cadence.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared, project-agnostic engineering skills for the JS/TS ecosystem — React, Next.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL/Drizzle, TypeScript, Zod, security, and Mermaid — reused by namespaced reference from other plugins.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: A read-only research subagent that investigates a codebase or the web and reports findings with evidence.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: A read-only subagent that semantically reviews a diff for onion-architecture, DI-container, and Next.js RSC-boundary violations.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: A Spec-Driven Development agent pipeline — spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer, plan-verifier — orchestrated end to end by the run-plan skill.
